name: paritok-vscode
description: Route your VS Code AI assistant (Continue / Cline) through a local Paritok proxy to compress tool-call & file context and cut token cost.

paritok.host.description: Host the local proxy binds to.

paritok.port.description: Port the local proxy listens on. The AI assistant's base URL is pointed here.

paritok.upstream.description: Continue only: which API surface the created/redirected model uses. 'anthropic' → http://host:port ; 'openai' → http://host:port/v1. (Claude Code and Codex ignore this.)

paritok.codexModel.description: Codex only: pin a model in ~/.codex/config.toml. Leave empty (recommended) to let Codex choose — its own picker / -m flag / default. A pinned 'gpt-5' is rejected by ChatGPT-account Codex.

paritok.paritokCommand.description: The paritok CLI executable. Change if it is not on PATH (e.g. an absolute path to the venv's paritok).

paritok.pythonCommand.description: Python launcher used for 'Install CLI (pip)'. Leave empty to auto-detect (python / python3 / py).

paritok.autoStart.description: Deprecated / no longer needed: enabled agents now always re-establish on launch (and their configs are auto-restored if the proxy can't start), so Codex/Continue never point at a dead proxy.

paritok.assistantConfigPath.description: Override the path to the assistant's config.json (Continue: ~/.continue/config.json). Leave empty to auto-detect.

paritok.configFile.description: Path to a paritok.yaml you manage yourself. When set, the extension uses it AS-IS and never overwrites it (and the paritok.* engine settings below are ignored). Run 'Paritok: Open Config' to create/edit it. Leave empty to let the extension generate the config from the settings below.

paritok.useGpuServer.markdownDescription: Backend: `true` = Paritok GPU server (needs an API key); `false` = self-host the open model locally via Ollama (uses the `localModel*` settings).

paritok.gpuServerBaseUrl.description: GPU server endpoint (used when useGpuServer is true).

paritok.localModelBaseUrl.description: Self-hosted model endpoint (used when useGpuServer is false).

paritok.compressionMinTokens.description: Skip compression below this many tokens.

paritok.compressionMaxTokens.description: Skip compression above this many tokens.

paritok.compressionRefusalThreshold.description: Must save at least this fraction (0.05 = 5%) or keep the original.

paritok.historyKeepRecentTurns.description: Keep the last N turns intact (uncompressed).

paritok.historyContextThreshold.description: Compress old turns once more than this fraction of the window is used.

paritok.historyContextWindow.description: Model context window (tokens) used for the history threshold.

paritok.toolDiscoveryStrategy.description: How to trim tool schemas: embedding (semantic), relevance (top-K), or passthrough (keep all).

paritok.toolDiscoveryTopK.description: relevance strategy: keep the top-K tool schemas, stub the rest.

paritok.toolDiscoveryKMax.description: embedding strategy: max tools kept in full schema.

paritok.toolDiscoveryAdaptive.description: embedding strategy: coding tasks drop unselected MCP tools; MCP tasks stub them.

paritok.toolDiscoveryMcpSignalThreshold.description: embedding strategy: MCP-signal threshold for adaptive apply.

paritok.traceEnabled.description: Log every original→compressed pair for debugging.

paritok.tracePath.description: File to write the compression trace to (when traceEnabled).

paritok.shadowStorage.description: Where [REF] shadow content lives. redis persists across restarts (needs paritok[redis]).
